_about: Readings for signs Kiraly & Tokai leave undefined, made their way: guessed from one passage, then checked at every occurrence in the book. Tier A fits every occurrence checked or is proved by an identical formula or a numeral; B fits most; C is a guess. Keys are glyph codes minus E000, three hex digits per glyph.

060.evidence: a single tally stroke. 'Saint Luke in [one] chapter of his book' at 021r:2, 059v:2, 076r:2, 008v:7; two strokes is K&T's own 'two'

060060060.evidence: three strokes. Peter denies [thrice] 032v:3; third denial then the cock crows 040r:6; third prayer in the garden 034r:8; [three] nails 054r:5; Lord Lord Lord, Father 084r:7; rose the [third] day 162r:9; three Hail Marys 145v:7

060060060060060.evidence: five strokes. brake the [five] loaves, [five] thousand people 022v:2; [five] confessed, then first/second/third/fourth follow 023r:11; chapter ten-ten-[five] = 25 at 072r:4

812060060060.evidence: Abel, [the third] was Seth 007v:8; the [third] part 016v:3; first, second, [third] asked 068v:12 and 080r:9; the [three] apostles Peter, John.. 033r:5; [thirdly] confessed 023v:1; appeared to Mary Magdalene [the third time] 190v:3. 21 of 21

910.evidence: a single glyph after a noun that then acts: Seth [-] went 006r:6; Anne [-] the Lord has heard 017v:1; the king [-] on his throne 015r:6; also as a suffix in Lord-910 and this-910. Grammatical, not lexical; K&T's name-for-pronoun rule plus this particle is most of the book's syntax

569910.evidence: K&T's 'this' + the subject marker. '[this is] the book of holy Moses' 086r:11; '[this is] truly drink' 096r:7 = John 6:55; '[this is] the commandment to the Lord' 005r:11

270910.evidence: K&T's 'Lord' + the subject marker. 'the Lord, [he] must suffer' 034v:2; 'the [Lord] appeared to Mary Magdalene' 190v:3

3c4.evidence: K&T's own published reading of 137v:3 puts 'sin' at this sign ('conceived Jesus without [sin]'); 'Lord, [our sin], have mercy' four times 141r:7 143r:8 144r:2 198v:5; Thomas through [sin] against the Lord God 009r:11. A second word in the sin field beside K&T's 'sin, sinner'

4b0.evidence: a speech root: the Jews [answered] Jesus of Nazareth 035v:3; Caiaphas asked, the [answer] 039r:8; second [said].. third [said] 039v:12; Pilate [said] to the Lord 039v:9; whom will ye [that I] release, Barabbas or Jesus 047v:7. About 50 of 75 are speech; the rest unclear

6154b0.evidence: 615 + the speech root; 'the Jews [answered]: Jesus of Nazareth' 035v:3, 035v:11, 036r:7

4a24a04a4.evidence: clause-initial narrative connective, one glyph from K&T's 'and'; before a subject or a speech verb 334 times. Could equally be a quotative 'said'

54060b.evidence: object pronoun: Eve ate [it], Adam 003v:10; took [it], and took the fruit 001r:3; Adam saw [her] 001r:5. One glyph from K&T's 'will, want'

ae0.evidence: K&T mark it 'var.' of a code they gloss day; forty [days] and forty nights 004v:11. Line-initial uses ('[that day] he called twelve apostles' 022r:10) fit loosely

060060443520.evidence: follows 'God the Father' in 8 of 10 uses; almighty or most high
